name: Monster colors: Emberpup and Voltail
notes: Shared colors of Emberpup and Voltail's sprites and portraits: 1 = dark outline, 2 = white, 3-8 = Emberpup's light / mid / dark body colors and 3 accent colors, 9-14 = Voltail's, 15 = pink blush. Light comes from the top-left: light on the upper-left, dark low on the right.
